asset.name: Hollow Delve cave landscape
asset.visual_description:
A broad natural cavern opens around an old haulage path cut into damp limestone.
Water darkens the blue-grey rock beneath blunt stalactites. Uneven timber
supports and rusted iron brackets mark the excavated sections; their feet sit
on stacks of stone shims. Two small oil lamps cast dull amber pools across the
worn rock. Thin shelves of pale fungus follow a seepage line on the rear wall.
Beyond the path, overlapping rock ledges fall away into a quiet, dark hollow.
Loose gravel and a narrow drainage channel collect at the edge of the raised
walking shelf, leaving its middle clear.

asset.name: Hollow Delve timber gallery
asset.visual_description:
A low excavated gallery follows a seam through damp blue-grey limestone.
Heavy dark timber uprights brace the rear wall, their feet resting on stacks of
stone shims. Rusted iron straps bind split beams. Two small oil lamps hang from
iron hooks. A level haulage shelf is worn smooth through its middle, with loose
gravel and a shallow drainage groove along the back edge. Uneven rock presses
between the supports, and dark recesses open beyond the last pools of lamplight.

asset.name: Hollow Delve sunken cavern
asset.visual_description:
A raised limestone shelf skirts a wide underground pool. Thin trickles darken
the cavern wall, and blunt stalactites hang over water almost black in the
recesses. Broken rock ledges overlap on the far bank. Sparse pale fungus clings
to damp shelves close to the waterline. A single hooded oil lamp rests in a
rock niche above the path, its small amber reflection caught in the still pool.
The walking shelf remains dry and level above the water.
